title: Mailroom Schedule: Release Notice Envelope Charge, Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
The release envelope charge follows how the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate travels and whether any other transmission of the filing was sent today.

| Certificate travels by | Another transmission of the filing sent today | Release envelope charge |
|---|---|---|
| Paper mail | Yes — the release notice rides with it | 1.25 (enclosure) |
| Paper mail | No | 9.85 (certified mail) |
| Electronic transmission | Either | None |

How a certificate travels is the transmission method in its timetable. "Another transmission" is any transmission on the filing's record, other than the release notice itself, whose transmission date is today — an amendment, a corrected refiling, a reinstatement filing or any other document sent to the state that day.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Paper-mail certificate; an amendment transmission dated today is on the record: 1.25.
- Paper-mail certificate; the latest other transmission is dated two weeks ago: 9.85.
- Electronic certificate: none.
